findings.why: The ASL still shows APR-009 as approved with no end date. The 8D says the HB-620 approval for Fonderia Dora was revoked on 2026-09-15, after the 2026-09-01 meeting and before today (2026-11-14). The revocation is therefore in force, and the ASL entry is outdated. Continued ordering has no current approval.
